Voting rules

One participant, one ballot

  1. Only official RU and Nigeria region members are eligible.
  2. Vote only in the region where you are officially registered.
  3. Select one or two games on a single ballot.
  4. Duplicate and cross-region ballots will not be counted.
  5. No paid votes. The highest weighted score wins.
  6. For flexible games, 1v1 or 2v2 depends on registration numbers.
